_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Pi agent's local-model list.
_policy: Agentic (tool-capable) models ONLY. Reasoning-only models (FuseO1, DeepSeek-R1) are deliberately excluded — they do not tool-call and 400 the agent. They live in Continue/chat configs, not here. See docs/decisions/ADR-001-agentic-only-single-source-of-truth.md.
_bridge: baseUrl uses the Docker bridge 172.17.0.1 for devcontainers. On the host itself, localhost:11434 is equivalent; the installer rewrites it per environment.
